Benediction

Sam Xifaras June 13, 2026

Today is a new day.

Today is a new life.

I will be kind today.

I will love today.

I will be generous today.

I will speak truth today.

I will not boast today.

I will not speak ill of anyone today.

I will not be jealous today.

I will treat today like my last day.

Amen.
